correctness.rationale: For a simplicial automorphism group, points fixed in a simplex are equal-weight orbit barycenters, giving PL-homeomorphic orbit simplicial complex using only vertex-orbits which are faces. Apply to ordinary wheel edge matchings: all nontrivial spoke orbits are invalid because spokes share the center; rim rotation orbits are indexed by residues mod gcd and conflict as cycle C_g (K2 for g2). Explicit odd/even reflection axis configurations give isolated fixed spoke K1, K2 opposing fixed spokes or admissible rim-orbit paths with claimed counts. Independence complex of graph disjoint union is a join; standard Ind(P_t) ≃ ΣInd(P_(t-3)) and Ind(C_g) period-three recurrence yield claimed integral homotopy. Independently enumerated actual admissible wheel-edge orbits/conflict graphs for all n=5..20 and all nonidentity dihedral actions and checked path/K2/cycle templates; these tests are bounded, with general proof structural.
